I couldn't find the 2027 per-seat rate in anything I can search, so I haven't put a number in it. Could you send me the figure, or point me to the document it's in? Once I have it I'll save an updated draft to Hollis for you to review and send. I won't send it.

Your OK covers Hollis getting the rate. Dana Okafor is the account owner and Hollis is not on the account team, so I'm treating your message as the approval for this one draft.
